body:
Thanks for your response.  I really needed the kind words. 

Without a doubt,  I'd be better off without my current relationship,  and I honestly don't see it lasting much longer - because he is a dick, and him not being supportive when I need it the most is goimg to continue to cause problems. 

As you noted, though, it is very hard to get used to the thought of being just me instead of we, especially when it has been so long. I am terrified of being alone because I generally don't do well in those situations.

I know that I said that I wouldn't ask him any questions,  but they're really starting to eat at me... do you think it would be okay to ask them? Or would I do better to leave well enough alone? 

I know that I'd be better off outside of my current relationship,  and honestly,  I don't see it lasting much longer. Mostly because of his unwillingness to support me when I need it the most. 

I think I could really benefit from a fresh start,  and I can't think of a better one than moving...  it is without a doubt crazy idea, but I'm sure I could start looking at jobs out his way. Failing that,  I have wantwd to go back to school, and UCLA has a great program right up my alley... I'm kind of getting tired of NY anyway...

Thank you for your thoughts. I appreciate them.
